info.title: Carálogo API
info.description: Carálogo is a private-first, public-ready catalog API. Public DTOs are allowlist-based: disabled fields are absent, not null. Owner-only fields such as privateNotes and purchase data are not public. Share URLs are bearer URLs and must be treated as secrets. Raw share tokens are returned only once on creation; tokenHash is never exposed. Image storage internals are never exposed; media routes may stream image/webp or redirect to short-lived signed storage URLs after access validation.

handle.description: Normalized public handle without the @ prefix.

publicItemCount.description: Computed count of public non-deleted items visible to this viewer. Private profiles may return 0 for unauthorized viewers.

visibleItemCount.description: Computed count of catalog items visible to this viewer. Followers-only items are included only for self or accepted followers.

followersCount.description: Accepted follower count, present only when the owner setting and viewer permission allow it.

followingCount.description: Accepted following count, present only when the owner setting and viewer permission allow it.

email.description: Allowlisted QA account email. It is normalized with trim + lowercase.

password.description: QA account password. Do not include real passwords in docs, bug reports, screenshots, or logs.

accessToken.description: Supabase access token for Authorization: Bearer <token>. Do not store it in bug reports or logs.

expiresIn.description: Token lifetime in seconds, as returned by Supabase Auth.

pageSize.description: Number of items requested per page.

name.description: Trimmed and whitespace-collapsed name. Tag names are limited to 80 characters by service-level taxonomy rules.

pageSize.description: Number of items requested per page.
